findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 18 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 65 questions numbered 1-65; by section: 18.1 6, 18.2 10, 18.3 9, 18.4 3, 18.5 3, 18.6 9, 18.7 7, 18.8 6, 18.9 5, 18.10 7.

Covers sections 18.1-18.10 in order; comparison questions are answered as two-column tables; every number (ΔE = hc/λ, ν = c/λ, Kstab, Kstab ratios, E°cell, mole ratios, oxidation states) was recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise. Book corrections followed: E°(CO₂/C₂O₄²⁻) = −0.49 V with E°cell = +2.01 V and 16H⁺ in the balanced equation, E°(Fe³⁺/Fe²⁺) = +0.77 V with E°cell = +0.75 V and 5Fe³⁺ + 8H⁺, multipliers 2 (MnO₄⁻) and 5 (C₂O₄²⁻), ammonia complex of Cu(II) as [Cu(NH₃)₄(H₂O)₂]²⁺, two isomers for [MA₄B₂].
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
